about: Labelled question set for the episodic-window measurement of 2026-10-12. Run over a store holding sessions 04, 11, 12-moved and 13 to 17 of this directory (session-12.md is the alternative move note and is not part of this set). Each question carries one retrieval shape: 'window' asks what held or happened in a world-time interval; 'lookup' asks a stable fact; 'current_state' asks the present value of a slot that changed; 'relationship' asks how two entities relate; 'exact_term' turns on a proper name a paraphrase would lose. 'expected' is the gold answer; 'must_include' are the facts a correct answer states; 'must_exclude' are facts a correct answer must not present as in scope (for a window question, an event outside the window, including one said inside it). The non-window questions are controls, so a failure on a window question can be told apart from a retrieval-quality failure.
